description: This file contains utility functions for splitting a string into tokens and storing them in a linked list.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on spaces and stores them in a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the linked list if it is valid (not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (non-empty).
